name: Sundae <> Deal Champs Meetup
headline: AI, Real Estate & What's Next.
summary: Sundae and Stratton Brown of Deal Champs bring local real estate investors together in Fresno for an evening of networking and an open conversation with Sundae co-founder and CEO Josh Stech: how AI is changing real estate, where seller opportunities are emerging, and what successful operators do differently to acquire inventory and close deals. It is Deal Champs' final meetup in Fresno. Guests register on Sundae's page and receive the exact location.
strategy: Drive registrations to Sundae's page (meet.sundae.com/fresno-nov-2026): Deal Champs' own community first, then Josh's personal invitations, the marketplace list, partner groups and a small paid push, with reminders and confirmations so registrants show up.
creativeNote: Designed in Sundae's brand from real photos only: Josh Stech's photos from sundae.com, the Sacramento dinner photo (captioned as Sacramento) and openly licensed photos of Fresno itself (the Old Fresno Water Tower and the downtown skyline, credited on every asset; they show the city, not the venue). Copy follows Sundae's event page. QR codes go to the registration page. No AI footage. Videos and Reels are silent by design: add trending audio in-app for organic posts and a licensed track for ads.
sources: Event facts from Sundae's registration page, meet.sundae.com/fresno-nov-2026 (read Oct. 21, 2026): name, date, 6-8:30 p.m. PT, Deal Champs and Stratton Brown, the three topics and Josh's bio. The exact location is shared only with registered guests. Budgets and projections are the Manhattan Beach base case, labeled assumptions. City photos: Mel B. (CC BY 2.0) and DoulosBen (CC BY 4.0).
